complete_examples.text: First, a flexible wheelset modeled by Timoshenko beam with variable cross sections is introduced and coupled into the rigid–flexible multi-body vehicle–track interaction model previously established by the finite elemental matrix coupling method.

The wheelset subsystem is modelled as a rigid–flexible body including the flexible Timoshenko beam with variable cross sections, characteriz-ing the wheelset vertical vibration, and the rigid body, char-acterizing the wheelset lateral vibration.
